runtime_evidence.label: CoreS3 cache-line B observation, 2026-10-21, build.24
runtime_evidence.notes: Exact flash hashes and boot ELF verified; 8 MB PSRAM memory test, Wi-Fi, MQTT, wake startup observed. 80 AI playback windows in generation 5: mean wall 1111.04 ms per 1024 ms audio, AEC wrapper 32984.14 us. Two capture-overflow events in all sampled windows (one in sustained playback). Final playback drained RX/decoded/written=10855, RX overflow=0. Performance target FAIL; approximate cloud-audio scenario, settings values unconfirmed. A2 rollback to build.23 observed 25 sustained-playback windows: wall 1199.76 ms/1024 ms, AEC 36339.92 us, one capture-overflow event. A2 is below planned 30 samples; acoustic/full-product acceptance remains pending. Device restored to build.23; defaults/build tree retain the unaccepted 64 B candidate.

runtime_evidence.label: Cache A2 rollback and six AI lifecycle cycles, 2026-10-21, build.23
runtime_evidence.notes: Restored exact build.23 identity, NVS preserved. A2: 25 sustained playback windows, mean wall 1199.76 ms/1024 ms, AEC wrapper 36339.92 us, one observed capture overflow. Below planned 30 windows. Six serial AI start/stop cycles generations 2..7: active then waiting, last-error=0, wake listening restored. Largest internal block 24576 throughout. Transient heap reduction recovered during idle to pre-cycle level. Acoustic double-talk, touch, weak-network and other media modes not certified; no L6 claim.

runtime_evidence.label: CoreS3 caption PSRAM runtime, 2026-10-21, build.25
runtime_evidence.notes: Native three-image flash verified, boot version/ELF prefix match, PSRAM test and bound Wi-Fi/MQTT startup pass. Six AI cycles generations 2..7 enter active then waiting/wake, last-error=0. Final idle internal-free=53895 and largest=29696 stable at 92/122/152 seconds, PSRAM-free=6587944. 61 sampled sustained-playback windows: mean wall/audio=1086.95/1024 ms, AEC wrapper=31866.11 us, one observed capture overflow; realtime target not met. Initial playback RX/decoded/written=10157, decode/I2S/RX-overflow=0. One reconnect generation recorded media dropped=1, cause unresolved. Visual captions/touch, subjective audio, double-talk, NVS save/unbind and other media modes not certified. No L6 claim. Device left build.25 waiting with wake enabled; serial observer closed. Subsequent user session 8 feedback: interruption difficult and recognition often poor even with playback stopped; acoustic acceptance FAIL (user reported). Read-only status confirmed same firmware and session, no decode/I2S errors; historical counters cannot localize the near-end speech loss. Follow-up controlled tests: quiet complete-sentence recognition 3/3 correct; one complete-sentence barge-in correct. At about 30 cm, formula short-phrase barge-in required two repetitions and only the final part was recognized. Subsequent controlled quiet formula recognized correctly once. Double-talk acceptance remains FAIL; these limited quiet passes do not certify all speech. No tuning applied.

issues.description: Official webpage audio table reverses GPIO13/14 relative to schematic page2/3 and official BSP. Use RX14/TX13.
Physical PCB/panel revision, camera orientation, real TDM slots, AEC double talk, runtime memory and all network flows need exact-artifact HIL.

Octal configuration corrected to schematic U7 Quad. User build.9 log confirms 8MB/80MHz PSRAM and memory-test PASS, then enters app_main. Version/time/ELF prefix match local build.9; not a current-image HIL certificate.

User build.9 photo shows corrupted LCD. Production lvgl_init overwrote native ILI9342 320x240 with LCKFB swap_xy/mirror_x, shrinking column address space to 240. Regression reproduces mismatch; board-owned rotation corrects it. New display firmware needs panel/color/four-corner-touch HIL.

User build.12 has near-end recognition while silent but poor barge-in during playback: MIC clipping and AEC processing above 32 ms budget. Official CoreS3 BSP PA gain compensation omission corrected in build.14; no HIL yet. ES7210 requested 33 dB maps to 30 dB in locked driver. See OFFICIAL_AUDIO_REVIEW.md.
